rules: Strictly limit total word count to between 90 and 105 words to hit the 42-second runtime sweet spot.
Assign the hook, 3-2-1 pause prompt, and closing question to Narrator 1, while Narrator 2 handles the core explanation.
Keep titles under 65 characters and lead with strong curiosity triggers like 'Why' or 'How'.
Use exclusively high-definition real footage or clean animated vector diagrams, completely avoiding AI-generated imagery.
Position the 'pause and predict' banner strictly between seconds 20 and 25 with a clear 3-2-1 countdown.
Never include subscribe/like CTAs, sensationalized fear, health advice, or misleading clickbait.

Extreme animal biomechanics because unique natural adaptations consistently pull high daily view velocities.
